column1: # Armory weapon table - the source of truth for ui/loadout/. One row = one weapon in
# the picker. Regenerate the pages with: python docs/tools/gen_loadout.py build
# id       two-digit page id, also the tile number in ui/coop_loadout.urc
# tik      weapon model handed to the preview and to the slot
# xfm      preview transform, HAND-DIALLED per gun (x y z scale pitch yaw roll)
# charanim coop_hold_* pose used by the preview
# name     grid + slot label, upper case
# b0..b3   the four stat bars, as the coop_bfN texture number
# clip     clip_<n> texture; clipn the printed round count
# slots    which inventory slots accept it: 1,2 primary  3 pistol  4 heavy
# The hover unlock text (req<id>.cfg) is NOT a column: gen_loadout derives it from the
# scripts that grant the unlock (challenges.scr, xp.scr, loadoutpick.scr).
